drafts.Draft A:
I thank my God every time I remember you. Whenever I pray for all of you, I pray with joy because you have shared in spreading the good news from the first day until now. I am sure that the One who began this good work among you will keep working until it is complete when Christ Jesus returns.

I have good reason to feel this way about all of you because I carry you in my heart. You share with me in God’s grace, both while I am in prison and while I defend the good news and show that it is true. God knows how deeply I long for all of you with the tender love of Christ Jesus.

This is my prayer: that your love will keep growing, along with knowledge and wise judgment, so you can recognize what matters most. Then you will live with integrity and without blame when Christ returns, filled with the good fruit of right living that comes through Jesus Christ and brings glory and praise to God.
drafts.Draft B:
I thank my God in every remembrance of you, always making my prayer for all of you with joy, because of your partnership in the good news from the first day until now. I am confident of this very thing: the One who began a good work among you will bring it to completion by the day of Christ Jesus.

It is right for me to think this way about all of you because I have you in my heart. All of you share with me in grace, both in my imprisonment and in the defense and confirmation of the good news. God is my witness that I long for all of you with the deep affection of Christ Jesus.

And this I pray: that your love may grow still more in knowledge and every kind of discernment, so that you may test and approve what truly matters and be sincere and blameless for the day of Christ, filled with the fruit of righteousness that comes through Jesus Christ, to the glory and praise of God.
drafts.Draft C:
I thank my God whenever I remember you. Every time I pray for all of you, I pray with joy because you have worked alongside me for the good news from the first day until now. I am sure of this: the One who began a good work among you will continue it until it is finished on the day Christ Jesus returns.

I have good reason to feel this way about all of you because I carry you in my heart. You all share with me in God’s grace, whether I am in prison or defending and confirming the truth of the good news. God knows how deeply I long for all of you with the tender love that comes from Christ Jesus.

This is what I pray for you: that your love will keep growing as you gain knowledge and learn to make wise judgments. Then you will be able to recognize what matters most and live with integrity and without blame when Christ returns. Your lives will be filled with the good fruit of right living that comes through Jesus Christ, bringing glory and praise to God.
